note_tweet.text:
muse is the first ai my wife let me put on her phone.

her #1 goal, help remove 163,490 promotional emails sitting in her gmail. Shes tried for years by hand, but gmail always freezes when selecting that many. 

Muse took 3 days, hit multiple gmail limits, but worked around them, and just cleared it all out. 

shes impressed (for someone who hates ai).
